metadata.what: Kodak Elite Chrome Extra Color 100: Kodak's consumer edition of the film in kodak_ektachrome_e100vs.
metadata.data: None of its own. KODAK ELITE Chrome Extra Color 100 Film (publication E-126) publishes the same spectral sensitivity, characteristic and dye density curves as KODAK PROFESSIONAL EKTACHROME Film E100VS (E-163): digitised from both sheets they agree to within 0.0002 (log sensitivity, density). The engine loads kodak_ektachrome_e100vs and overrides only the name.
